evals.prompt: Use eval-author to tell me which sub-flow should check whether an inherited repository of Harbor tasks is runnable. Only give the route and the evidence that would justify a runnable verdict; do not execute it or create files.
evals.expected_output: Select eval-author-discover. Harbor validators and execution evidence, rather than merely finding task files, establish readiness. Do not claim any checks ran.
assertions: Selects eval-author-discover.
Does not claim the suite is runnable without evidence.
Does not modify the workspace.

evals.prompt: My agent has no evaluation suite and no ETHOS.md. For now, just tell me the appropriate workflow for building my first evals and its first prerequisite. Do not run commands or create files.
evals.expected_output: Route to eval-author-first-eval through shared setup and Ethos confirmation before constructing a starter suite. Begin with the agent and evaluation setup, then establish intended behavior through ethos-orchestrate. Production traces and an existing coverage audit are not prerequisites. This explanation-only request does not start onboarding.
assertions: Selects eval-author-first-eval.
Identifies shared setup and Ethos confirmation, starting with the agent and evaluation setup, rather than an independent Ethos interview.
Does not claim evaluations were built or executed.

evals.prompt: We previously discussed interpreting a failed run, but my request has changed: I now want to turn one recorded interaction into a private reproducible Harbor task. Only identify the right sub-flow and evidence needed before calling the result ready. Do not fetch traces or build anything.
evals.expected_output: Select eval-author-trace-environment rather than trace inspection. Trace evidence grounds the task; retained Harbor proof and required review establish readiness. A successful original trace alone is insufficient.
assertions: Honors the latest request to derive an environment.
Selects eval-author-trace-environment.
Does not invent successful proof or claim readiness.

evals.prompt: Use eval-author to help me improve my existing Gym evaluations for the Catalog assistant. I wrote the suite myself, have never audited it, and have no traces or ETHOS.md. I will supply the suite files when we get to the evaluation work. The repository is /workspace/input; its README.md describes the agent. Gym is not installed yet, but I want to begin the work that can proceed without it. My model credentials are not configured. You may read the supplied documentation. Start with setup and intended behavior; stop at the first unanswered question or missing skill dependency, before designing cases, changing files, or running evaluations.
evals.expected_output: Begins shared prerequisite and Ethos confirmation for Gym, with Improve your existing evaluations as the selected outcome. Reuses the supplied repository and agent information, distinguishes missing or reported setup from verified execution, and pauses for the next genuinely missing answer. Leaves Ethos pending if an earlier question or dependency blocks this checkpoint; if reached, uses ethos-orchestrate or reports it unavailable. Does not require traces, an audit, or execution credentials to begin; does not author evaluations or claim completed Ethos confirmation. No files are written in this checkpoint.
assertions: Shows the three-item checkbox checklist with Check how your agent runs and how you’ll test it, Agree on how your agent behaves using ETHOS.md, and Improve your existing evaluations; links ETHOS.md to https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills/blob/main/skills/ethos-orchestrate/README.md and identifies the current step without marking unfinished work complete
Preserves the selected setup and supplied agent/repository context; uses the supplied documentation when proceeding and asks only for unresolved prerequisites or intent
Treats reported setup availability as user-supplied information, not runtime verification; missing execution credentials do not block prerequisite or Ethos discussion

If the checkpoint reaches Ethos work, uses ethos-orchestrate or reports its unavailability with the supplied context retained; otherwise leaves Ethos pending. Never substitutes an independent writer or claims unconfirmed content is approved
Does not require traces or a previous audit, run runtime probes or evaluations, design cases, or write files; keeps unfinished decisions in the conversation
Keeps the expansion goal and selected provider; does not force an audit or require an Eval Author-created suite or prior planning artifact
